label: Anthropic
description: Anthropic API key + Claude Code coding agent for Settings → LLMs. Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show Anthropic under Providers & Keys and Claude Code under Coding Agents.

settings.sections.title: Anthropic prompt caching
settings.sections.description: Bill-discount cache_control markers on API calls. Separate from Ducky's freeze prefix (works for all providers).

properties.label: Enable Anthropic cache markers
properties.description: Sends Anthropic cache_control on the stable system prefix, tools, and latest message.

properties.label: Extended cache TTL (1h)
properties.description: Uses Anthropic's 1-hour ephemeral cache instead of the default 5-minute window.

steps.title: Providers & Keys
steps.body: Anthropic lives under Settings → LLMs. Open Providers & Keys to paste your API key and turn on Claude Code.
